20 The Chapter of / the Name of the Fathers. /
The name 'father', as the Father of Greatness, supremely designates the ultimate God and source of all divinity. However, it can also properly be used of the derived gods in their own realms of greatness. Compare chapters 7 and 25.
[On]ce again the enlightener speaks to his disciples: The [Father / of] Greatness, as he is named; due to what reason is he given the name 'the Father / [of] Greatness'?
